_comment: Naming convention: <surface>_<element>_<role>. Surface = where the string appears (account_setup, settings, compose, …). Element = which UI thing inside that surface. Role = label / placeholder / hint / error / button / etc. Keep keys snake_case so they look good in autocomplete and don't fight ESLint identifier rules. Add new keys when you touch a string; the codebase is migrated lazily — see CLAUDE.md → i18n.
settings_general_language_hint: Change which language Unkai Mail uses for its UI. The new language takes effect after the next restart.
settings_general_language_auto_hint: Use the language reported by your operating system. Turn off to pin a specific language regardless of system setting.
settings_general_language_restart_body: The new language will be applied the next time Unkai Mail starts.
settings_general_file_assoc_hint: Unkai is registered with your operating system as a possible handler. Mark it as the default in your OS settings to have double-clicked calendar invites and email files open here.
settings_mail_conversation_view_hint: Bundle replies in the same thread under a single row with an expand chevron. Turn off to see every message as its own row in date order.
account_setup_welcome_subtitle: Let's set up your email account
account_setup_account_name_hint: How this account is labelled inside Unkai.
account_setup_your_name_hint: Shown as the sender on outgoing mail. Defaults to the account name when empty.
account_setup_imap_explainer: IMAP is the protocol used to receive your emails. Port 993 uses TLS encryption (recommended).
account_setup_password_hint: Stored securely in your OS keychain — never written to disk in plain text.
account_setup_smtp_explainer: SMTP is the protocol used to send your emails. Port 587 uses STARTTLS encryption (recommended).
account_setup_jmap_hint: Modern push-based mail protocol. Only enable if your provider supports it.
account_setup_signature_hint: Appended to new messages sent from this account. You can change it later in Settings.
signature_popout_button_title: Edit signature in a separate window
signature_popout_button_aria: Open signature editor in a separate window
signature_popout_locked_banner: Editing in pop-out window — close that window to edit here again.
signature_popout_placeholder: Appended to new messages sent from this account.
signature_popout_missing_state: No popout state found for this signature editor window.
signature_popout_account_missing: The account this window was opened for is no longer configured.
account_setup_validation_step0: Please fill in the account name and email address.
account_setup_validation_step1: Please enter your IMAP server hostname and password.
account_setup_validation_step2: Please enter your SMTP server hostname.
account_setup_discovery_hint_fallback: Couldn't auto-discover {domain} — best-guess hostnames filled in. Edit if needed.
account_setup_cert_title: The server's TLS certificate isn't trusted by default.
account_setup_cert_explainer: This is normal for self-hosted mail servers using a self-signed certificate. Compare the fingerprint below with your server's actual certificate before trusting.
account_setup_cert_probe_failed: Could not retrieve the server certificate to display: {reason}
account_setup_cert_trusting_one: Trusting 1 self-signed certificate for this account.
account_setup_cert_trusting_many: Trusting {n} self-signed certificates for this account.
compose_attachment_warning_title: You mentioned an attachment but didn't attach a file.
compose_attachment_warning_body: Add a file before sending, or dismiss this warning if it's a false alarm.
compose_forward_attachments_body_one: The forwarded message has 1 attachment. Add it to your forward?
compose_forward_attachments_body_many: The forwarded message has {n} attachments. Add them to your forward?
compose_pgp_recipient_no_key_title: No PGP key for some recipients
compose_pgp_recipient_no_key_body: We don't have a public key on file for: {addresses}. The encrypted send will fail until you import a key or remove these recipients.
mail_decrypt_for_reply_body: Enter your PGP passphrase to decrypt the message from {sender} so your reply can quote the original content.
mail_decrypt_for_forward_body: Enter your PGP passphrase to decrypt the message from {sender} so the forward carries the original content.
nc_share_expiration_aria: Pick expiration date for the share link
nc_share_expiration_hint: Recipients can't open the link after this date.
contact_form_placeholder_notes: Anything you want to remember about this contact
contact_view_empty_state: No contact details to show yet.
outbox_banner_empty: The Outbox is empty. Mail you send appears here briefly while it's on its way.
outbox_banner_failed: {count} messages couldn't be sent yet — Unkai will keep retrying on every sync. You can retry now, edit, or discard each one.
outbox_banner_failed_singular: 1 message couldn't be sent yet — Unkai will keep retrying on every sync. You can retry now, edit, or discard it.
outbox_banner_in_flight: {count} messages in flight. They'll move to Sent once the server confirms.
outbox_banner_in_flight_singular: 1 message in flight. It'll move to Sent once the server confirms.
outbox_button_retry_with_passphrase_titl: Re-supply your PGP passphrase and try sending this encrypted message again
outbox_button_edit_title: Re-open this message in Compose to edit it
outbox_passphrase_explain: This message is encrypted with your OpenPGP key. Enter your passphrase to unlock the key and retry the send.
outbox_view_unreadable: This queued message couldn't be parsed for preview.
event_editor_readonly_banner: This calendar is read-only — you can view this event, but changes can't be saved.
event_planner_no_attendees: Add at least one attendee to see availability.
event_planner_source_local_title: From your own calendars (this person isn't a Nextcloud user, or their calendar isn't shared with you).
settings_location_geocoding_help: Off by default. When on, the event editor's Location field offers geocoded suggestions with an inline map preview, and the contact form's Addresses section suggests matching street addresses as you type. Each typed query goes to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service and the event-editor map loads tiles from openstreetmap.org — both third-party services outside your Nextcloud.
settings_nominatim_base_url_hint: Leave empty to use the public OpenStreetMap Nominatim service. To route queries through your own self-hosted Nominatim instead, paste its base URL (e.g. https://nominatim.example.com).
settings_notes_mail_open_in_view_hint: When on, clicking a mail link inside a note flips the main view to the inbox at that message. When off (default), the message opens in a standalone reader window so the Notes view stays put.
mail_view_message_gone: This message no longer exists on the server.
encryption_no_key_explanation: Import an OpenPGP private key to sign outgoing mail and decrypt incoming mail on this account. The armored key is stored in the OS keychain; the passphrase is not retained.
encryption_passphrase_hint: The passphrase is used once to verify the key parses, then dropped. Compose will prompt for it again on every encrypted send.
mail_view_cannot_decrypt_banner: This message is encrypted. The server didn't expose the raw bytes so it can't be decrypted here — open it via IMAP or a desktop PGP client.
mail_view_attachment_decrypt_required: Please re-enter your passphrase via the Decrypt button below to open this attachment.
contact_form_hint_pgp_keys: Paste an ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key. Round-trips through the contact's vCard and is also cached locally so Compose can encrypt to this address.
encryption_unlock_auto_hint_off: Off — Compose asks for your PGP passphrase on every encrypted send, and encrypted mail shows a Decrypt button you have to click.
encryption_unlock_auto_storage_hint: Stored in the OS keychain alongside this account's mail password. Removing the PGP key here clears it; toggling this off also clears it.
compose_pgp_auto_unlock_active: Auto-unlock is on — your saved passphrase will be used.
shares_view_no_matches: No share links match this search.
shares_view_no_account_html: No Nextcloud account connected. Add one under Settings → Nextcloud first.
shares_view_pick_account_hint: Pick an account to view its share links.
shares_view_empty_html: No share links yet. Share files from Nextcloud Files or Compose's "Attach from Nextcloud" picker to mint your first link.
shares_view_open_title: Open this share in your browser
shares_view_revoke_confirm:
Revoke the share link for "{name}"?

The link will stop working for anyone who has it — there's no undo.
shares_edit_expiration_aria: Pick expiration date for the share link
shares_edit_expiration_hint: Recipients can't open the link after this date.
